column4: Hegel P20, P30 RC-5 code table
All commands meant to be used repeatedly must be programmed with two separate HEX codes to work as intended.
Program your remote so that using the command multiple times in a row alternates between the original and the alternate HEX codes.
1st use of the command: Use the original HEX code
2nd use of the command: Use the alternate (alt) HEX code
3rd use of the command: Use the original HEX code again
By alternating between the two HEX codes in this manner your Hegel device will register each command individually.
This will prevent the command from freezing.
